scope: Static suitability assessment of one exact existing QEMU GPIO implementation for the next actual S9 public-ROM dependency. No acquired code executed.
primary_basis: UG585v1.12.2 Chapter14 pp389–395: pin paths, five interrupt trigger modes, aligned32-bit access, clock and bus-reset scope.
UG585v1.12.2 AppendixB gpio pp1346–1373: exact bank/register widths, masks, access types and reset values.

comparison.source: Six banks26/26/26/32/32/32 with174pins and threeMIO banks.
comparison.required: Four banks32/22/32/32 with118pins, twoMIO banks and32-bit aligned MMIO only.
comparison.change: Profile/bounds data alone can handle widths and absent banks.

comparison.source: Each bank calls qemu_set_irq on the same line; the last bank replaces earlier assertions.
comparison.required: OR all unmasked bank status bits into IRQ52.
comparison.literal_counterexample: bank0status1/unmasked; all laterstatus0 => source ends low, required high.
comparison.change: Replace IRQ reduction and all relevant update hooks.

comparison.source: Only polarity is used. A falling event deposits level0; TYPE and ANY do not affect detection.
comparison.required: Rising/falling/either-edge latches; active-low/high levels remain asserted until source deasserts.
comparison.literal_counterexample: Falling configured, old1/new0, clearstatus => source stores0, required latched1. TYPE0activehigh held1 must assert without another transition.
comparison.change: Replace interrupt detection/state and W1C/update behavior.

comparison.source: Input callback changes DATA only when DIRM0; DATA_RO returns that same DATA register.
comparison.required: DATA remains output latch. DATA_RO observes independent settled pad/input value, with explicit unknown/unavailable pins.
comparison.literal_counterexample: Write output latch1, keep inputmode, supply external0 => DATA must remain1 and DATA_RO0.
comparison.change: Separate output latch, input samples and their known masks.

comparison.source: DATA writes invoke input ISR for every pin before the output-enable check; upper-half update offsets reuse low-bit interrupt positions.
comparison.required: Interrupt detector observes the input signal, not an unconnected output-register write.
comparison.change: Separate output notification from external settled-input detector; no implicit board feedback.

comparison.source: EN/DIS change mask storage but do not recompute IRQ.
comparison.required: Unmasking a pending event exposes it; masking removes it from shared reduction.
Upper16mask reads0; lowhalf reads selected prior output-latch half, including sixvalid highbits of bank1.
comparison.change: Return actual selected stored data and unknown mask.

comparison.source: Only OEN changes drive enable notifications; DIRM has no such hook; rawOEN forwarded.
comparison.required: Controller output-enable intent is DIRM&OEN; physical MIO TRI_ENABLE and pin mux remain separate.
comparison.change: Recompute from both registers and do not infer external pin level.

comparison.source: All DATA cold state defaults0; mask defaultsallones. Later reset skips DATA only and resets remainingregisters.
comparison.required: UG585 MIO DATA resetunknown, EMIO DATA reset0; mask reset0. GPIO_CPU1X_RST resets onlybusinterface, notcontrollerlogic.
comparison.change: Explicit reset kinds and input/latch knowledge. Do not equate QMP warm reset with cold power reset.

decision: Profile-only reuse is insufficient. Correcting the candidate requires replacing its input/output state and interrupt behavioral core, not just width constants. Retain this original as independent reference; use the existing QEMU CPU/register/bus infrastructure and a small new Rust behavioral core if root selects that route. Do not keep two competing PS GPIO models.
reuse_available: Existing QEMU CPU, SysBus/MMIO/qdev IRQ infrastructure and existing Rust static-library ABI.
The archived mask-data formula and register offsets are useful cross-checks, not acceptance oracles for their known differing behaviors.
proposed_interface: read32(offset)->word with explicit value/known bits, or access error; no unpredictable WO read manufactured.
write32(offset,value)->success/error, rejecting unaligned/non32bit/absent offsets before mutation.
cold_reset versus bus_interface_reset; separate supplied settled input value/known mask.
Controller output latch plus DIRM/OEN intent; independent pad/EMIO binding and shared IRQ known/unknown result.
required_tests: Literal masked-data vector0xBDEF4210 from the manual; bank1six-bit upperhalf and absentbanks.
Independent five-mode interrupt truth table, multi-bankOR, maskedpending/unmask, W1C/reassert and output-latch independence.
Coldunknown MIO versus knownEMIO reset, busresetretention, invalidaccess no mutation and unknown input/IRQ propagation.
QEMU qtest must issue actual fourbank INT_DIS writes from the originalROM and test realreadback; continue originalROM only after strict component checks.
open_limits: Physical MIOmux/strap/pull and inputclock synchronization need separate exactboard binding. Bank0bits7/8 cannot be generalinputs.
The manual lists reset values but does not license invented S9 pin levels. No unknown value can be silently converted tozero at the guestboundary.
No source-based profile claim proves physicalS9/silicon compatibility.
